title: UK channel rollout: partner announcement & field playbook (draft)
audience: UK channel sales, partner success, marketing, field enablement, legal
objective: Give sales and partners a concise set of assets and scripts to announce Redwood Inference availability in the UK region, highlight differentiation for regulated and public sector prospects, and kick off partner-led pilots with early pricing and compliance guidance.
key_messages: Redwood now offers local UK-hosted inference with predictable latency and enterprise SLAs — built for production LLMs, not experiments.
We provide flexible deployment: hosted API, Dedicated reserved capacity, and Private (VPC/on‑prem) for regulated customers — same API surface across modes.
Focus on economics: intelligent batching, caching, and quantization guidance mean lower per-token costs compared to ad-hoc self-hosting.
Security and compliance: UK data residency options, KMS/HSM integrations, and audit logs tailored for public sector needs.
Operational reliability: canary rollouts, automatic fallback routing, and per-route observability reduce live risk for mission-critical applications.
competitive_notes: High-level: AWS Bedrock and Azure Applied AI are positioned on cloud convenience and deep cloud integrations; Anthropic emphasizes safety and model-level guardrails; Cohere and Mistral push simple developer ergonomics and embedded models. Primary play: lead with production economics and predictable latency + dedicated/private options for regulated customers. Call out we are easier to tune for cost (batching + cache profiles) and have built-in fallbacks for availability. For public sector, stress VPC + audited logs. Watch out for discounts and procurement cadence from major cloud providers and managed service vendors. Reference recent competitor pricing from GTMP-3324 and notes in CONFLUENCE-UK-ROLLOUT-5201.
launch_timeline: Week 0: partner comms + portal access (invite list in PR:87). Week 1: joint webinar and sales training. Week 2-4: 5 pilot customers onboarded per partner (target). Week 6: collect pilot feedback, finalize pricing guidance. Week 8: wider partner announcement and marketplace listing. Exact dates: see JIRA GTMP-3324 milestones.
roles_and_ops: Field lead: Miguel Alvarez (partner ops). Enablement owner: Priya Desai. CS escalation: Sadia Rahman. Legal & compliance counsel: Hiro Tanaka. Partner package: prepopulated onboarding docs, a one-click sandbox tenant for UK region, step-by-step Private deployment checklist, and a sample SOW template. Escalation path: #uk-sales > partner-ops > eng-oncall (see roster in Confluence).
email_announcement_draft:
Subject: Redwood Inference — UK region & partner pilot program now open

Hi [Partner name],

We’re excited to invite you to join Redwood’s UK channel pilot. We now offer UK-hosted inference with Dedicated and Private deployment options that meet public sector security needs. Our goal is to run 4–6 joint pilots over the next month to prove latency, cost savings, and rollout plans for your customers.

What we provide: a sandbox tenant in the UK, onboarding checklist, joint GTM collateral, and a partner success manager.

Immediate asks: confirm up to three pilot customers and nominate an internal technical lead by EOD Friday. We’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff with product and engineering to scope integration work.

Thanks,
Zara Bennett
Head of Partner GTM
Redwood Inference
slack_announcement_snippet: UK launch update: partners invited to pilot UK-hosted inference (sandbox live). Partners get Dedicated/Private options and partner success support. Kickoff session next Tue 10am UK. DM @zara.bennett to join list.
faq: Q: Is UK data physically stored in the UK? A: Yes — the sandbox and dedicated clusters for this program are in the London region. We also offer Private deployments in customer VPCs where data never leaves the customer network.
Q: What SLAs are available for pilot customers? A: Pilot SLAs are lighter — 99% availability target for early pilots. Production SLA template is available for Dedicated contracts post-pilot.

Q: How do we price for pilots? A: Temporary promotional credits plus a simplified per-token guidance spreadsheet (see linked PR). After pilot success we recommend a reserved capacity commit or usage-based contract with a burst option.
Q: Can partners resell? A: Yes — we have an approved reseller playbook (requires partner agreement, see legal contact).
metrics_and_kpis: Primary KPIs: number of partners enrolled (target 8), pilots started (target 16), pilots converted to paid within 90 days (target 50%), average latency improvement vs incumbent (target 30% median), reduction in per-token cost vs self-host baseline (target 25%). Track in GTM dashboard and update weekly in #uk-sales.
